summary: Proven recipes and your own workflows
state_open: ComfyUI {version} is open on this PC ({url}).
state_launched: ComfyUI {version} is running, launched by AIODOS without a window.
state_found: ComfyUI {version} is installed on this PC, closed for now.
state_found_launch: ComfyUI {version} is installed, closed: AIODOS will launch it without a window for your creations.
state_absent: ComfyUI is not installed on this PC.
install_help: The button opens the official ComfyUI Desktop download page in your browser: in this version, AIODOS downloads nothing itself (several GB). Once ComfyUI is installed, come back here: it will be found automatically.
absent_phone: ComfyUI cannot be installed on a phone: your ComfyUI creations run on your machines that have it.
not_granted: AIODOS does not use this ComfyUI yet.
grant_text: AIODOS will send your creations to this PC's ComfyUI, along with the jobs of the applications you allow (the same setting as in Settings → Other tools). Nothing is installed or downloaded.
launch_help: Open ComfyUI, or let AIODOS launch it without a window for a creation: it stops 10 minutes after the last one.
recipes_help: Proven workflows, taken from ComfyUI's official templates, with no added node: AIODOS always builds their graph itself.
unsigned_help: Not signed by the author yet: it serves on this PC and on your machines, never for the public network.
typical: ≈ {seconds} s with a {gb} GB graphics card
model_unpinned_help: The author has not recorded its fingerprint yet: AIODOS does not download it. ComfyUI Desktop can download it when you open the template.
model_no_comfyui_help: Install ComfyUI: its models go into its folders.
download_text: {size}, from Hugging Face, into ComfyUI's model folders. License: {license} ({url}). By downloading it, you accept its license; everyone remains responsible for how they use it.
not_ready: Models are missing, here and on your machines.

create_started.one: Creation started: it will appear in the gallery.
create_started.other: {n} creations started: they will appear in the gallery.

workflows_help: Import a workflow exported from ComfyUI ("Export (API)"), 2 MB at most: its settings are found automatically. It never leaves your machines.
too_big: File too large: 2 MB at most.
delete_text: It is removed from AIODOS; the file exported from ComfyUI stays where it is.
waiting: Waiting for ComfyUI, here or on one of your machines
